segments.dn12:1.1: Lohiccabrāhmaṇavatthu Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena sālavatikā tadavasari.
segments.dn12:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena lohicco brāhmaṇo sālavatikaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ, brahmadeyyaṃ.
segments.dn12:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti –
segments.dn12:2.2: “idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya, kiñhi paro parassa karissati.
segments.dn12:2.3: Seyyathāpi nāma purāṇaṃ bandhanaṃ chinditvā aññaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ kareyya, evaṃsampadamidaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi, kiñhi paro parassa karissatī”ti.
segments.dn12:3.2: “samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sālavatikaṃ anuppatto.
segments.dn12:3.3: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.dn12:3.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’.
segments.dn12:3.5: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
segments.dn12:3.6: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
segments.dn12:3.7: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.dn12:4.1: Atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo rosikaṃ [bhesikaṃ (sī. pī.)] nhāpitaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn12:4.2: “ehi tvaṃ, samma rosike, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha – lohicco, bho gotama, brāhmaṇo bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī”ti.
segments.dn12:4.5: “adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ gotamo lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.dn12:5.1: “Evaṃ, bho”ti [evaṃ bhanteti (sī. pī.)] kho rosikā nhāpito lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rosikā nhāpito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn12:5.2: “lohicco, bhante, brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati;
segments.dn12:5.3: evañca vadeti – adhivāsetu kira, bhante, bhagavā lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
segments.dn12:6.1: Atha kho rosikā nhāpito bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena lohicco brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā lohiccaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn12:6.2: “avocumhā kho mayaṃ bhoto [mayaṃ bhante tava (sī. pī.)] vacanena taṃ bhagavantaṃ –
segments.dn12:6.3: ‘lohicco, bhante, brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati;
segments.dn12:6.4: evañca vadeti – adhivāsetu kira, bhante, bhagavā lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
segments.dn12:7.1: Atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi –
segments.dn12:7.2: “ehi tvaṃ, samma rosike, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā samaṇassa gotamassa kālaṃ ārocehi – kālo bho, gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan”ti.
segments.dn12:7.4: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho rosikā nhāpito lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.dn12:7.5: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rosikā nhāpito bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi –
segments.dn12:7.7: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena sālavatikā tenupasaṅkami.
segments.dn12:8.1: Tena kho pana samayena rosikā nhāpito bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho hoti.
segments.dn12:8.2: Atha kho rosikā nhāpito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn12:8.3: “lohiccassa, bhante, brāhmaṇassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ –
segments.dn12:8.4: ‘idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya – kiñhi paro parassa karissati.
segments.dn12:8.6: Seyyathāpi nāma purāṇaṃ bandhanaṃ chinditvā aññaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ kareyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi – kiñhi paro parassa karissatī’ti.
segments.dn12:8.9: Sādhu, bhante, bhagavā lohiccaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetū”ti.
segments.dn12:8.10: “Appeva nāma siyā rosike, appeva nāma siyā rosike”ti.
segments.dn12:9.1: Atha kho bhagavā yena lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.dn12:9.2: Atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
segments.dn12:9.3.0: Lohiccabrāhmaṇānuyogo Atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.dn12:9.5: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho lohiccaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.dn12:9.6: “saccaṃ kira te, lohicca, evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ –
segments.dn12:9.7: ‘idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya – kiñhi paro parassa karissati.
segments.dn12:9.8: Seyyathāpi nāma purāṇaṃ bandhanaṃ chinditvā aññaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ kareyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi, kiñhi paro parassa karissatī’”ti?
segments.dn12:10.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi lohicca nanu tvaṃ sālavatikaṃ ajjhāvasasī”ti?
segments.dn12:10.6: Yā sālavatikāya samudayasañjāti lohiccova taṃ brāhmaṇo ekako paribhuñjeyya, na aññesaṃ dadeyyā’ti.
segments.dn12:10.7: Evaṃ vādī so ye taṃ upajīvanti, tesaṃ antarāyakaro vā hoti, no vā”ti?
segments.dn12:10.9: “Antarāyakaro samāno hitānukampī vā tesaṃ hoti ahitānukampī vā”ti?
segments.dn12:10.11: “Ahitānukampissa mettaṃ vā tesu cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sapattakaṃ vā”ti?
segments.dn12:10.13: “Sapattake citte paccupaṭṭhite micchādiṭṭhi vā hoti sammādiṭṭhi vā”ti?
segments.dn12:10.15: “Micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ, lohicca, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā”.
segments.dn12:11.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, lohicca, nanu rājā pasenadi kosalo kāsikosalaṃ ajjhāvasatī”ti?
segments.dn12:11.6: yā kāsikosale samudayasañjāti, rājāva taṃ pasenadi kosalo ekako paribhuñjeyya, na aññesaṃ dadeyyā’ti.
segments.dn12:11.7: Evaṃ vādī so ye rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ upajīvanti tumhe ceva aññe ca, tesaṃ antarāyakaro vā hoti, no vā”ti?
segments.dn12:11.9: “Antarāyakaro samāno hitānukampī vā tesaṃ hoti ahitānukampī vā”ti?
segments.dn12:11.11: “Ahitānukampissa mettaṃ vā tesu cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sapattakaṃ vā”ti?
segments.dn12:11.13: “Sapattake citte paccupaṭṭhite micchādiṭṭhi vā hoti sammādiṭṭhi vā”ti?
segments.dn12:11.15: “Micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ, lohicca, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā”.
segments.dn12:12.3: yā sālavatikāya samudayasañjāti, lohiccova taṃ brāhmaṇo ekako paribhuñjeyya, na aññesaṃ dadeyyā”ti.
segments.dn12:13.1: Evaṃvādī so ye taṃ upajīvanti, tesaṃ antarāyakaro hoti.
segments.dn12:13.2: Antarāyakaro samāno ahitānukampī hoti, ahitānukampissa sapattakaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti, sapattake citte paccupaṭṭhite micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.dn12:13.3: Evameva kho, lohicca, yo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.dn12:13.4: “idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya, kiñhi paro parassa karissati.
segments.dn12:13.5: Seyyathāpi nāma purāṇaṃ bandhanaṃ chinditvā aññaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ kareyya … pe … karissatī”ti.
segments.dn12:13.7: Evaṃvādī so ye te kulaputtā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchanti, sotāpattiphalampi sacchikaronti, sakadāgāmiphalampi sacchikaronti, anāgāmiphalampi sacchikaronti, arahattampi sacchikaronti, ye cime dibbā gabbhā paripācenti dibbānaṃ bhavānaṃ abhinibbattiyā, tesaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, antarāyakaro samāno ahitānukampī hoti, ahitānukampissa sapattakaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti, sapattake citte paccupaṭṭhite micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.dn12:13.8: Micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ, lohicca, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā.
segments.dn12:14.3: yā kāsikosale samudayasañjāti, rājāva taṃ pasenadi kosalo ekako paribhuñjeyya, na aññesaṃ dadeyyā”ti.
segments.dn12:15.1: Evaṃvādī so ye rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ upajīvanti tumhe ceva aññe ca, tesaṃ antarāyakaro hoti.
segments.dn12:15.2: Antarāyakaro samāno ahitānukampī hoti, ahitānukampissa sapattakaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti, sapattake citte paccupaṭṭhite micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.dn12:15.3: Evameva kho, lohicca, yo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.dn12:15.4: “idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya, kiñhi paro parassa karissati.
segments.dn12:15.5: Seyyathāpi nāma … pe … kiñhi paro parassa karissatī”ti, evaṃ vādī so ye te kulaputtā tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchanti, sotāpattiphalampi sacchikaronti, sakadāgāmiphalampi sacchikaronti, anāgāmiphalampi sacchikaronti, arahattampi sacchikaronti.
segments.dn12:15.8: Ye cime dibbā gabbhā paripācenti dibbānaṃ bhavānaṃ abhinibbattiyā, tesaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, antarāyakaro samāno ahitānukampī hoti, ahitānukampissa sapattakaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti, sapattake citte paccupaṭṭhite micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
segments.dn12:15.10: Micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ, lohicca, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā.
segments.dn12:16.1: “Tayo khome, lohicca, satthāro, ye loke codanārahā;
segments.dn12:16.2: yo ca panevarūpe satthāro codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjā.
segments.dn12:16.4: Idha, lohicca, ekacco satthā yassatthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, svāssa sāmaññattho ananuppatto hoti.
segments.dn12:16.5: So taṃ sāmaññatthaṃ ananupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.dn12:16.7: Tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.
segments.dn12:16.9: “āyasmā kho yassatthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, so te sāmaññattho ananuppatto, taṃ tvaṃ sāmaññatthaṃ ananupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi –
segments.dn12:16.11: Tassa te sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.
segments.dn12:16.12: Seyyathāpi nāma osakkantiyā vā ussakkeyya, parammukhiṃ vā āliṅgeyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi – kiñhi paro parassa karissatī”ti.
segments.dn12:16.15: Ayaṃ kho, lohicca, paṭhamo satthā, yo loke codanāraho;
segments.dn12:16.16: yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjā.
segments.dn12:17.1: “Puna caparaṃ, lohicca, idhekacco satthā yassatthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, svāssa sāmaññattho ananuppatto hoti.
segments.dn12:17.2: So taṃ sāmaññatthaṃ ananupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.dn12:17.4: Tassa sāvakā sussūsanti, sotaṃ odahanti, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, na ca vokkamma satthusāsanā vattanti.
segments.dn12:17.6: “āyasmā kho yassatthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, so te sāmaññattho ananuppatto. Taṃ tvaṃ sāmaññatthaṃ ananupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi –
segments.dn12:17.8: Tassa te sāvakā sussūsanti, sotaṃ odahanti, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, na ca vokkamma satthusāsanā vattanti.
segments.dn12:17.9: Seyyathāpi nāma sakaṃ khettaṃ ohāya paraṃ khettaṃ niddāyitabbaṃ maññeyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi – kiñhi paro parassa karissatī”ti.
segments.dn12:17.10: Ayaṃ kho, lohicca, dutiyo satthā, yo, loke codanāraho;
segments.dn12:17.11: yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjā.
segments.dn12:18.1: “Puna caparaṃ, lohicca, idhekacco satthā yassatthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, svāssa sāmaññattho anuppatto hoti.
segments.dn12:18.2: So taṃ sāmaññatthaṃ anupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.dn12:18.4: Tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.
segments.dn12:18.6: “āyasmā kho yassatthāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, so te sāmaññattho anuppatto.
segments.dn12:18.7: Taṃ tvaṃ sāmaññatthaṃ anupāpuṇitvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi –
segments.dn12:18.9: Tassa te sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.
segments.dn12:18.10: Seyyathāpi nāma purāṇaṃ bandhanaṃ chinditvā aññaṃ navaṃ bandhanaṃ kareyya, evaṃ sampadamidaṃ pāpakaṃ lobhadhammaṃ vadāmi, kiñhi paro parassa karissatī”ti.
segments.dn12:18.12: Ayaṃ kho, lohicca, tatiyo satthā, yo loke codanāraho;
segments.dn12:18.13: yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjā.
segments.dn12:18.14: Ime kho, lohicca, tayo satthāro, ye loke codanārahā, yo ca panevarūpe satthāro codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjāti.
segments.dn12:19.1: Evaṃ vutte, lohicco brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn12:19.2: “atthi pana, bho gotama, koci satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho”ti?
segments.dn12:19.3: “Atthi kho, lohicca, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho”ti.
segments.dn12:19.4: “Katamo pana so, bho gotama, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho”ti?
segments.dn12:20-55.1: “Idha, lohicca, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ, sammāsambuddho … pe …(yathā 190-212 anucchedesu evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).
segments.dn12:20-55.2: Evaṃ kho, lohicca, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati … yasmiṃ kho, lohicca, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati, ayampi kho, lohicca, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho.
segments.dn12:20-55.5: Yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā abhūtā atacchā adhammikā sāvajjā … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.dn12:56-62.5: Yasmiṃ kho, lohicca, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati, ayampi kho, lohicca, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho, yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā abhūtā atacchā adhammikā sāvajjā … ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti … pe … yasmiṃ kho, lohicca, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati, ayampi kho, lohicca, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho, yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā abhūtā atacchā adhammikā sāvajjā … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
segments.dn12:63-77.6: Yasmiṃ kho, lohicca, satthari sāvako evarūpaṃ uḷāraṃ visesaṃ adhigacchati, ayampi kho, lohicca, satthā, yo loke nacodanāraho, yo ca panevarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā abhūtā atacchā adhammikā sāvajjā”ti.
segments.dn12:78.1: Evaṃ vutte, lohicco brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.dn12:78.2: “seyyathāpi, bho gotama, puriso purisaṃ narakapapātaṃ patantaṃ kesesu gahetvā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhapeyya, evamevāhaṃ bhotā gotamena narakapapātaṃ papatanto uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpito.
segments.dn12:78.4: Abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, seyyathāpi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya,‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī’ti.
segments.dn12:78.5: Evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
segments.dn12:78.6: Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.dn12:78.7: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Sālavatikāti tassa gāmassa nāmaṃ, so kira vatiyā viya samantato sālapantiyā parikkhitto.
502-503. Pāpakanti parānukampā virahitattā lāmakaṃ, na pana ucchedasassatānaṃ aññataraṃ.
Uppannaṃ hotīti jātaṃ hoti, na kevalañca citte jātamattameva.
So kira tassa vasena parisamajjhepi evaṃ bhāsatiyeva.
Kiñhi paro parassāti paro yo anusāsīyati, so tassa anusāsakassa kiṃ karissati.
Attanā paṭiladdhaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ attanāva sakkatvā garuṃ katvā vihātabbanti vadati.
504-407. Rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesīti rosikāti evaṃ itthiliṅgavasena laddhanāmaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi.
So kira bhagavato āgamanaṃ sutvā cintesi –
“vihāraṃ gantvā diṭṭhaṃ nāmaṃ bhāro, gehaṃ pana āṇāpetvā passissāmi ceva yathāsatti ca āgantukabhikkhaṃ dassāmī”ti, tasmā evaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi.
Piṭṭhito piṭṭhitoti kathāphāsukatthaṃ pacchato pacchato anubandho hoti.
Ayaṃ kira upāsako lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa piyasahāyako.
Appeva nāma siyāti ettha paṭhamavacanena bhagavā gajjati, dutiyavacanena anugajjati.
Ayaṃ kirettha adhippāyo – rosike etadatthameva mayā cattāri asaṅkhyeyyāni.

Kappasatasahassañca vividhāni dukkarāni karontena pāramiyo pūritā, etadatthameva sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, na me lohiccassa diṭṭhigataṃ bhindituṃ bhāroti, imamatthaṃ dassento paṭhamavacanena bhagavā gajjati.

Kevalaṃ rosike lohiccassa mama santike āgamanaṃ vā nisajjā vā allāpasallāpo vā hotu, sacepi lohiccasadisānaṃ satasahassassa kaṅkhā hoti, paṭibalo ahaṃ vinodetuṃ lohiccassa pana ekassa diṭṭhivinodane mayhaṃ ko bhāroti imamatthaṃ dassento dutiyavacanena bhagavā anugajjatīti veditabbo.
Samudayasañjātīti samudayassa sañjāti bhoguppādo, tato uṭṭhitaṃ dhanadhaññanti attho.
Ye taṃ upajīvantīti ye ñātiparijanadāsakammakarādayo janā taṃ nissāya jīvanti.
Anukampatīti anukampī, icchatīti attho, vuḍḍhiṃ icchati vā no vāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vāti sace sā micchādiṭṭhi sampajjati, niyatā hoti, ekaṃsena niraye nibbattati, no ce, tiracchānayoniyaṃ nibbattatīti attho.
510-512. Idāni yasmā yathā attano lābhantarāyena sattā saṃvijjanti na tathā paresaṃ, tasmā suṭṭhutaraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pavecetukāmo “taṃ kiṃ maññasī”ti dutiyaṃ upapattimāha.
Ye cimeti ye ca ime tathāgatassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā ariyabhūmiṃ okkamituṃ asakkontā kulaputtā dibbā gabbhāti upayogatthe paccattavacanaṃ, dibbe gabbheti attho.
Dibbā, gabbhāti ca channaṃ devalokānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Paripācentīti devalokagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pūrayamānā dānaṃ, dadamānā, sīlaṃ rakkhamānā, gandhamālādīhi, pūjaṃ kurumānā bhāvanaṃ bhāvayamānā pācenti vipācenti paripācenti pariṇāmaṃ gamenti.
Dibbānaṃ bhavānaṃ abhinibbattiyāti dibbabhavā nāma devānaṃ vimānāni, tesaṃ nibbattanatthāyāti attho.
Dibbā bhavāti devaloke vipākakkhandhā, tesaṃ nibbattanatthāya tāni puññāni karontīti attho.
Iti bhagavā ettāvatā aniyamiteneva opammavidhinā yāva bhavaggā uggataṃ brāhmaṇassa mānaṃ bhinditvā idāni codanārahe tayo satthāre dassetuṃ “tayo kho me, lohiccā”tiādimāha.
Tattha sā codanāti tayo satthāre codentassa codanā.
Na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapentīti aññāya ājānanatthāya cittaṃ na upaṭṭhapenti.
Vokkammāti nirantaraṃ tassa sāsanaṃ akatvā tato ukkamitvā vattantīti attho.
Osakkantiyā vā ussakkeyyāti paṭikkamantiyā upagaccheyya, anicchantiyā iccheyya, ekāya sampayogaṃ anicchantiyā eko iccheyyāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Parammukhiṃ vā āliṅgeyyāti daṭṭhumpi anicchamānaṃ parammukhiṃ ṭhitaṃ pacchato gantvā āliṅgeyya.
Evaṃsampadamidanti imassāpi satthuno “mama ime sāvakā”ti sāsanā vokkamma vattamānepi te lobhena anusāsato imaṃ lobhadhammaṃ evaṃsampadameva īdisameva vadāmi.
Iti so evarūpo tava lobhadhammo yena tvaṃ osakkantiyā ussakkanto viya parammukhiṃ āliṅganto viya ahosītipi taṃ codanaṃ arahati.
Kiñhi paro parassa karissatīti yena dhammena pare anusāsi, attānameva tāva tattha sampādehi, ujuṃ karohi.
Kiñhi paro parassa karissatīti codanaṃ arahati.

Tatiyacodanāya kiñhi paro parassāti anusāsanaṃ asampaṭicchanakālato paṭṭhāya paro anusāsitabbo, parassa anusāsakassa kiṃ karissatīti nanu tattha appossukkataṃ āpajjitvā attanā paṭividdhadhammaṃ attanāva mānetvā pūjetvā vihātabbanti evaṃ codanaṃ arahatīti attho.
Na codanārahoti ayañhi yasmā paṭhamameva attānaṃ patirūpe patiṭṭhāpetvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
Sāvakā cassa assavā hutvā yathānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjanti, tāya ca paṭipattiyā mahantaṃ visesamadhigacchanti.
Narakapapātaṃ papatantoti mayā gahitāya diṭṭhiyā ahaṃ narakapapātaṃ papatanto.
Uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpitoti taṃ diṭṭhiṃ bhinditvā dhammadesanāhatthena apāyapatanato uddharitvā saggamaggathale ṭhapitomhīti vadati.
Lohito nāma tassa kule pubbapuriso, tassa vasena lohiccoti tassa brāhmaṇassa gottato āgataṃ nāmaṃ.
“Diṭṭhigatan”ti laddhimattaṃ adhippetanti āha “na pana ucchedasassatānaṃ aññataran”ti.
Na hi ucchedasassatagāhavinimutto koci diṭṭhigāho atthi.
“Bhāsati yevā”ti tassā laddhiyā loke pākaṭabhāvaṃ dasseti.
Attato añño paroti yathā anusāsakato anusāsitabbo paro, evaṃ anusāsitabbatopi anusāsako paroti vuttaṃ “paro parassāti paro yo”tiādi.
Kiṃ -saddāpekkhāya cettha “karissatī”ti anāgatakālavacanaṃ, anāgatepi vā tena tassa kātabbaṃ natthīti dassanatthaṃ.
“Paresaṃ dhammaṃ kathessāmī”ti tehi attānaṃ parivārāpetvā vicaraṇaṃ kiṃ atthiyaṃ āsayabuddhassāpi anurodhena vinā taṃ na hotīti tasmā attanā paṭiladdhaṃ … pe … vihātabbanti vadati.
Kathāphāsukatthanti kathāsukhatthaṃ, sukhena kathaṃ kathetuñceva sotuñcāti attho.
Appeva nāma siyāti ettha pītivasena āmeḍitaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Bhagavā hi īdisesu ṭhānesu visesato pītisomanassajāto hoti.
Anupubbo kampī-saddo ākaṅkhanattho hotīti “icchatīti attho”ti vuttaṃ.
Sampajjatīti āsevanalābhena nippajjati balavatī hoti, avaggahāti attho, tenāha “niyatā hotī”ti.
510-11. Dutiyaṃ upapattinti “nanu rājā pasenadī kosalo”tiādinā dutiyaṃ upapattiṃ sādhanayuttiṃ.
Ye cimeti ye ca ime kulaputtā dibbā gabbhā paripācentīti yojanā.
Ye pana “paripaccantī”ti paṭhanti, tesaṃ “dibbe gabbhe”ti vacanavipallāsena payojanaṃ natthi.
Evañca katvā “bhāvanaṃ bhāvayamānā”ti idampi vacanaṃ samatthitaṃ hoti.
Bhavanti ettha yathāruci sukhasamappitāti bhavā, vimānāni.
Aniyamitenevāti aniyameneva “tvaṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiko evaṃ sattānaṃ anatthassa kārako”ti evaṃ anuddesikeneva.
Tayo satthāreti asampāditaattahito anovādakarasāvako, asampāditaattahito ovādakarasāvako, sampāditaattahito anovādakarasāvakoti ime tayo satthāre.
Catuttho pana sammāsambuddho na codanāraho hotīti “tena pucchite eva kathessāmī”ti codanārahe tayo satthāre paṭhamaṃ dassesi, pacchā catutthaṃsatthāraṃ.

Kāmañcettha catuttho satthā eko adutiyo anaññasādhāraṇo, tathāpi so yesaṃ uttarimanussadhammānaṃ vasena “dhammamayo kāyo”ti vuccati, tesaṃ samudāyabhūtopi te guṇāvayave satthuṭṭhāniye katvā dassento bhagavā “ayampi kho, lohicca, satthā”ti abhāsi.
Aññāti ya-kāralopena niddeso “sayaṃ abhiññā”ti ādīsu (dī. ni.1.28,37,52; ma. ni.1.284;2.341; a. ni.2.5;10.11; mahāva.11; dha. pa.353; kathā.405) viya.
Sāvakattaṃ paṭijānitvā ṭhitattā ekadesenassa sāsanaṃ karontīti āha “nirantaraṃ tassa sāsanaṃ akatvā”ti.
Eko iccheyyāti eko puriso tāya anicchantiyā sampayogaṃ kāmeyya.
Osakkanādimukhena itthipurisasambandhanidassanaṃ gehasitaapekkhāvasena tassa satthuno sāvakesu paṭipattīti dasseti.
Tattha sampādehīti tasmiṃ paṭipattidhamme patiṭṭhitaṃ katvā sampādehi.

Evaṃ codanaṃ arahatīti evaṃ vuttanayena sāvakesu appossukkabhāvāpādane niyojanavasena codanaṃ arahati, na paṭhamo viya “evarūpo tava lobhadhammo”tiādinā, na ca dutiyo viya “attānameva tāva tattha sampādehī”tiādinā.

“Na codanāraho”ti ettha yasmā codanārahatā nāma satthuvippaṭipattiyā vā sāvakavippaṭipattiyā vā ubhayavippaṭipattiyā vā, tayidaṃ sabbampi imasmiṃ satthari natthi, tasmā na codanārahoti imamatthaṃ dassetuṃ “ayañhī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Mayā gahitāya diṭṭhiyāti sabbaso anavajje sammāpaṭipanne paresaṃ sammadeva sammāpaṭipattiṃ dessente satthari abhūtadosāropanavasena micchāgahitāya nirayagāminiyā pāpadiṭṭhiyā.

Evaṃ kevaṭṭasuttaṃ saṃvaṇṇetvā idāni lohiccasuttaṃ saṃvaṇṇento yathānupubbaṃ saṃvaṇṇanokāsassa pattabhāvaṃ vibhāvetuṃ, kevaṭṭasuttassānantaraṃ saṅgītassa suttassa lohiccasuttabhāvaṃ vā pakāsetuṃ “evaṃ me sutaṃ … pe … kosalesūti lohiccasuttan”ti āha.
Lohito nāma tassa kule pubbapuriso, tabbaṃsavasena lohitassa apaccaṃ lohiccoti brāhmaṇassa gottato āgatanāmaṃ.
Na tu ucchedasassatānaṃ aññatarassāti āha “na panā”tiādi.
Diṭṭhigatanti hi laddhimattaṃ adhippetaṃ, aññathā ucchedasassataggāhavinimutto koci diṭṭhiggāho nāma natthīti tesamaññataraṃ siyā.
“Uppannaṃ hotī”ti idaṃ manasi, vacasi ca uppannatāsādhāraṇavacananti dasseti “na kevalañcā”tiādinā.
So kira … pe … bhāsatiyevāti ca tassā laddhiyā loke pākaṭabhāvaṃ vadati.
Yasmā pana attato añño paro hoti, tasmā yathā anusāsakato anusāsitabbo paro, evaṃ anusāsitabbatopi anusāsakoti dassetuṃ “paro”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Kiṃ -saddāpekkhāya cettha “karissatī”ti anāgatakālavacanaṃ, anāgatepi vā tena tassa kātabbaṃ natthīti dassanatthaṃ.
“Paresaṃ dhammaṃ kathessāmī”ti tehi attānaṃ parivārāpetvā vicaraṇaṃ kimatthiyaṃ, āsayavuddhassapi anurodhena vinā taṃ na hoti, tasmā attanā … pe … vihātabbanti vadati.
Bhāroti bhagavato parisabāhullattā, attano ca bahukiccakaraṇīyattā garu dukkaraṃ.
Kathāphāsukatthanti kathāsukhatthaṃ, sukhena kathaṃ kathetuñceva sotuñcāti attho.
Appeva nāma siyāti ettha pītivasena āmeḍitaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Bhagavā hi īdisesu ṭhānesu visesato pītisomanassajāto hoti, tasmā pītivasena paṭhamaṃ gajjati, dutiyampi anugajjati.
Ayaṃ aṭṭhakathāto aparo nayo – sātisayena hitena anukampako anuggaṇhanako hitānukampīti.
Sampajjatīti āsevanalābhena nippajjati, balavatī hoti avaggahāti attho.
510-511. Dutiyaṃ upapattinti “nanu rājā pasenadikosalo”tiādinā vuttaṃ dutiyaṃ upapattiṃ ṭhānaṃ yuttiṃ.
Kāraṇañhi bhagavā upamāmukhena dasseti, imāya ca upapattiyā tumhe ceva aññe cāti lohiccampi antokatvā saṃvejanaṃ kataṃ hoti.
Ye ca ime kulaputtā dibbā gabbhā paripācentīti yojanā.
Kammapadena atulyādhikaraṇattā paripācenti kiriyāya vibhattivipallāsena upayogatthe paccattavacanaṃ.
Ye pana “paripaccantī”ti kammarūpena paṭhanti, tesaṃ mate vibhattivipallāsena payojanaṃ natthi kammakattubhāvato, attho panassa dutiyavikappe vuttanayena dānādipuññaviseso veditabbo.
Evañca katvā “bhāvanaṃ bhāvayamānā”ti idampi vacanaṃ samatthitaṃ hoti.
“Devalokagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pūrayamānā”ti vatvā taṃ paṭipadaṃ sarūpato dassetuṃ “dānaṃ dadamānā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tadāvaho hi kammabhavo pubbe gahitoti āha “devaloke vipākakkhandhā”ti.
Aniyāmitenevāti aniyamiteneva,“tvaṃ evaṃ diṭṭhiko, evaṃ sattānaṃ anatthassa kārako”ti evaṃ anuddesikeneva.
Mānanti “ahametaṃ jānāmi, ahametaṃ passāmī”ti evaṃ pavattaṃ paṇḍitamānaṃ.
Tayo satthāreti asampāditaattahito anovādakarasāvako ca asampāditaattahito ovādakarasāvako ca sampāditaattahito anovādakarasāvako ceti ime tayo satthāre.
Catuttho pana sammāsambuddho na codanāraho, tasmā “taṃ tena pucchito eva kathessāmī”ti codanāraheva tayo satthāre paṭhamaṃ dasseti, pacchā catutthaṃ satthāraṃ.

Kāmañcettha catuttho satthā eko adutiyo anaññasādhāraṇo, tathāpi so yesaṃ uttarimanussadhammānaṃ vasena “dhammamayo kāyo”ti vuccati, tesaṃ samudāyabhūtopi te guṇāvayave satthuṭṭhāniye katvā dassento bhagavā “ayampi kho lohicca satthā”ti abhāsi.
Aññāti ya-kāralopaniddeso “sayaṃ abhiññā”tiādīsu (dī. ni.1.28,37; ma. ni.1.154,444) viya, tadatthe cetaṃ sampadānavacananti dasseti “aññāyā”tiādinā.
Sāvakattaṃ paṭijānitvā ṭhitattā ekadesenassa sāsanaṃ karontīti āha “nirantaraṃ tassa sāsanaṃ akatvā”ti.
Ukkamitvā ukkamitvāti kadāci tathā karaṇaṃ, kadāci tathā akaraṇañca sandhāya vicchāvacanaṃ, yadicchitaṃ karontīti adhippāyo.
Eko iccheyyāti adutiyo puriso sampayogaṃ iccheyyāti ānetvā sambandho.
Osakkanādimukhena itthipurisasambandhanidassanaṃ gehassitāgehassitaapekkhavasena tassa satthuno sāvakesu paṭipattidassanatthaṃ.
Tattha sampādehīti tasmiṃ paṭipattidhamme patiṭṭhitaṃ katvā sampādehi.

Evaṃ codanaṃ arahatīti vuttanayena sāvakesu appossukkabhāvāpādane niyojanavasena codanaṃ arahati, na paṭhamo viya “evarūpo tava lobhadhammo”tiādinā, na ca dutiyo viya “attānameva tāva tattha sampādehī”tiādinā.

Na codanārahoti ettha yasmā codanārahatā nāma satthuvippaṭipattiyā vā sāvakavippaṭipattiyā vā ubhayavippaṭipattiyā vā hoti, tayidaṃ sabbampi imasmiṃ satthari natthi, tasmā na codanārahoti imamatthaṃ dassetuṃ “ayañhī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Mayā gahitāya diṭṭhiyāti sabbaso anavajje anupavajje sammāpaṭipanne, paresañca sammadeva sammāpaṭipattiṃ dassente satthari abhūtadosāropanavasena micchāgahitāya nirayagāminiyā pāpadiṭṭhiyā.

Iti sumaṅgalavilāsiniyā dīghanikāyaṭṭhakathāya paramasukhumagambhīraduranubodhatthaparidīpanāya suvimalavipulapaññāveyyattiyajananāya sādhuvilāsiniyā nāma līnatthapakāsaniyā lohiccasuttavaṇṇanāya līnatthapakāsanā.
